TC-18/S23.title: Billing card states and the custom-template form pass axe (WCAG 2 A/AA)
TC-18/S23.detail: Our own addition (no UAT item or ticket asks for WCAG): recorded. axe on the card: result card (Hospital and Nursing Home) 1 serious color-contrast violation each, the grey '(none)' text under an empty element (text-slate-400; same pattern as A4); error / retry state 0; discharge prompt 0; Create Note Template form 0 (both contexts). The retry control is a named button, the two time choices are buttons '≤ 30 min' / '> 30 min' in a group 'Time on discharge', the Note Type field is labelled and required, every card state is an aria-live=polite region.
